name: shopify_customers_v1__Customer
description: One Shopify Customer per (shopId, id), where id is the customer's legacyResourceId.

name: shopify_discounts_v1__Discount
description: One Shopify discount per (shopId, id), where id is a DiscountCodeNode or DiscountAutomaticNode GID.

name: shopify_discounts_v1__DiscountRedeemCode
description: One Shopify DiscountRedeemCode per (shopId, id) — a redeemable code belonging to one discount.

name: shopify_inventory_v1__InventoryLevel
description: One Shopify InventoryLevel per (shopId, locationId, inventoryItemId) — a natural triple, because a level is the intersection of a location and an item and its own GID carries a query string.

name: shopify_locations_v1__Location
description: One Shopify Location per (shopId, id), where id is the location's legacyResourceId.

name: shopify_orders_v1__Order
description: One Shopify Order per (shopId, id), where id is the order's legacyResourceId.

name: shopify_orders_v1__OrderLineItem
description: One Shopify order line item per (shopId, id), where id is the numeric tail of the LineItem GID and orderId is parsed from the bulk JSONL __parentId.

name: shopify_products_v1__Product
description: One Shopify Product per (shopId, id), where id is the product's legacyResourceId.

name: shopify_products_v1__ProductVariant
description: One Shopify ProductVariant per (shopId, id), where id is the variant's legacyResourceId and productId is parsed from the bulk JSONL __parentId.

name: shopify_reports_v1__SalesDaily
description: One shop-local day of the Shopify ShopifyQL `sales` dataset per (shopId, day).

name: shopify_reports_v1__SessionsDaily
description: One shop-local day of the Shopify ShopifyQL `sessions` dataset per (shopId, day).

name: shopify_shop_v1__Shop
description: One row per Shopify store naming it: myshopify domain, trading name, timezone and shop currency, keyed by the Shopify shop id.
